# Phase 7 Algorithm-Only Baseline Fixtures

Baseline commit: c5c19f0

These fixtures capture the algorithm-only standalone output for all 9 parts,
produced by running `uv run python run.py partN` at the codebase state represented
by commit `c5c19f0` (post-Phase-6, no algorithm changes in Phase 7).

## Capture method

Phase 7 (commits c5c19f0..c3980fe) added only planning documents and test scaffolding;
no algorithm source code was changed.  Therefore, running the pipeline at current HEAD
produces bit-for-bit identical algorithmic output to running it at c5c19f0.  The
fixtures were captured from the VER-01 checkpoint runs executed during Phase 7 plan 03.

Each fixture was generated by:
1. Running `uv run python run.py partN` from the repo root (HEAD = c3980fe)
2. Reading `out/<run_id>/delta_packet.json`
3. Computing `missing_added_truth_indexes` by comparing evaluated items against the
   ground-truth added-pool using the same logic as `shop.services.review._load_missing_added_truth_items`
4. Writing the fixture with the normalised schema documented below

## Fixture schema

Each `partN-debug-report.json` contains exactly these top-level keys:

| Key | Type | Description |
|-----|------|-------------|
| `baseline_commit` | string | Git commit that defines this baseline (`c5c19f0`) |
| `packet_run_id` | string | `run_id` from the source `delta_packet.json` |
| `part_name` | string | Part identifier (e.g. `part1`) |
| `items` | array | Full `DeltaItem` list from the delta packet, including evaluations |
| `missing_added_truth_indexes` | array | Truth-row indexes for added characteristics not claimed by any packet item |
| `conforming_count` | integer | Count of items where `evaluation.status == "conforming"` |
| `review_needed_count` | integer | Count of items where `evaluation.status == "review_needed"` |

## Why not assets/debug_report_partN.json?

The `assets/debug_report_partN.json` files are web-export snapshots committed by the
Phase 6 corpus capture workflow.  They mix web-review-queue metadata with algorithmic
output and were exported from database runs that pre-date Phase 6's added-characteristic
detection improvements.  Using them as an algorithm regression baseline produces false
positives (parity artifacts) for Parts 1, 8, and 9.

The Phase 6 historical assets are intentionally left untouched so that
`tests/test_phase6_asset_regression.py` keeps its original evidence corpus.
See `.planning/phases/07-regression-tests-and-verification/07-04-ALGORITHM-ONLY-BASELINE.md`
for the full provenance record.
